llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed design-analysis helper, with limited privacy and third-party font CDN caveats users should understand.

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is to analyze a user-provided URL, HTML file, or screenshot and generate DESIGN.md plus previews; the documented WebFetch, local Read, and output generation fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions stay focused on design token extraction, document generation, previews, and optional validation commands; there is no hidden autonomous execution or unrelated data access.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown instructions and a template only; static scan found no findings and no executable scripts are included.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Fetching URLs and reading user-specified local files or screenshots is proportionate, but users should avoid sensitive internal pages, private HTML, or screenshots containing secrets unless they intend them to be analyzed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill creates local DESIGN.md and preview HTML artifacts and documents optional npx commands; it does not request credentials, background persistence, elevated privileges, or long-running workers.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable providing the pages, files, or screenshots you ask it to analyze. Review generated preview HTML before publishing or sharing it, especially the hard-coded fonts.loli.net and gstatic.loli.net font links, and treat the optional npx validation/export commands as external package execution.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: URL fetching, local HTML reading, and screenshot analysis are central to the skill's purpose and are disclosed, though explicit privacy guidance would improve user clarity.
[SQP-3] expected: The Google Fonts mirror rule is disclosed and limited to generated preview files; it introduces a third-party CDN dependency, but does not show hidden exfiltration, credential access, or automatic privileged behavior.
